topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
subtopic: Impact of Fees on Long-Term Returns
source_evidence: This is because fees and expenses reduce the amount of money in your investment portfolio earning a return.
question: Why can even small ongoing fees lower your investment returns over the long term?
answer: Fees reduce the amount of money in your portfolio that is earning a return. Although an ongoing fee may seem small, its effect can add up over time and make a significant difference to your portfolio’s value.
